TPMP_SOV_ord_intake = {
	# standing intake orders: only while the next order is short of workers; same price as the decisions
	if = {
		limit = {
			TPMP_SOV_ord_intake_open = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { TPMP_SOV_ord_in_pp_cd > 0 }
			}
			subtract_from_variable = { TPMP_SOV_ord_in_pp_cd = 7 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = TPMP_SOV_ord_in_pp
				check_variable = { TPMP_SOV_ord_in_pp_cd < 1 }
				check_variable = { TPMP_SOV_ord_short > 0 }
				has_political_power > 74
			}
			add_political_power = -75
			add_to_variable = { TPMP_SOV_workers_var = 100000 }
			set_variable = { TPMP_SOV_ord_in_pp_cd = 28 }
			add_to_variable = { TPMP_SOV_ord_intake_done = 1 }
			TPMP_SOV_ord_find_next = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { TPMP_SOV_ord_in_st_cd > 0 }
			}
			subtract_from_variable = { TPMP_SOV_ord_in_st_cd = 7 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = TPMP_SOV_ord_in_st
				check_variable = { TPMP_SOV_ord_in_st_cd < 1 }
				check_variable = { TPMP_SOV_ord_short > 0 }
				has_stability > 0.01
			}
			add_stability = -0.05
			add_to_variable = { TPMP_SOV_workers_var = 100000 }
			set_variable = { TPMP_SOV_ord_in_st_cd = 28 }
			add_to_variable = { TPMP_SOV_ord_intake_done = 1 }
			TPMP_SOV_ord_find_next = yes
		}
		if = {

				check_variable = { TPMP_SOV_ord_in_ws_cd > 0 }
			}
			subtract_from_variable = { TPMP_SOV_ord_in_ws_cd = 7 }

				has_country_flag = TPMP_SOV_ord_in_ws

				always = yes
